newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Gerdau group plans to launch ADRs in '97.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Gerdau group plans to launch ADRs in '97.

text.p: Brazilian steel and metal conglomerate Grupo Gerdau said it is planning to launch Level One American Depositary Receipts (ADR) in the first half of 1997.
The group's company selected to launch the ADRs was Gerdau S.A., formerly named Cosigua, it said.
Grupo Gerdau has three listed companies: Metalurgica Gerdau, Siderurgica Riograndense and Gerdau S.A.
The group reported a 70.4 million real net profit in the first nine months of 1996, an increase of 51.3 percent when compared with the same period of last year.
Gerdau's revenues rose 17.1 percent to 1.7 billion reais, while its output rose 6.5 percent to 2.6 million tonnes of steel. Exports totalled $100 million, with sales of 279,000 tonnes.

Gerdau also said it invested $60.2 million between January and September, of which 75 percent were invested in new equipment. The group plans to invest an additional $600 million over the next five years.
